name: Tones-and-Bones Skills
description: 8 Hermes-compatible skill advisors for luxury real estate sales and marketing automation
author: Bono G — ASAM Brain Series

commands.name: luxury-positioning
commands.description: Define and articulate a premium brand position for a luxury listing or agent identity. Outputs positioning statement, differentiators, and messaging pillars.

commands.name: ideal-client-profile
commands.description: Build a detailed Ideal Client Profile (ICP) for luxury real estate. Outputs demographics, psychographics, pain points, buying triggers, and targeting channels.

commands.name: brand-story
commands.description: Craft a compelling brand narrative for a luxury agent, team, or property. Outputs origin story, values statement, and 3 brand voice examples.

commands.name: sales-funnel
commands.description: Design a full luxury buyer/seller sales funnel. Outputs funnel stages, conversion actions, touchpoints, and automation triggers.

commands.name: client-experience
commands.description: Map and optimize the white-glove client experience. Outputs journey map, service rituals, surprise-and-delight moments, and NPS improvement plan.

commands.name: pricing-strategy
commands.description: Develop a premium pricing strategy with psychological anchor framing. Outputs tiered pricing model, anchor product, and price objection responses.

commands.name: referral-network
commands.description: Build a referral and affiliate partner ecosystem. Outputs partner categories, outreach templates, incentive structure, and CRM tagging system.

commands.name: automation-audit
commands.description: Audit the current CRM and marketing automation stack. Outputs gap analysis, automation score, GHL workflow recommendations, and 30-day fix list.
